overview: Credentials REST API for the NetApp Console

ai-gen.keywords: credentials,credential management,aws arn,azure service principal,encryption,sensitive data
ai-gen.lead: Securely manage and encrypt credentials and other sensitive data in the NetApp Console. The service handles generic credentials, Amazon Resource Name (ARN) credentials for AWS, and Azure service principal credentials.
Creates new service principal credentials in the credentials service API for a specified account public ID. Use this to authenticate and authorize access for the service principal.
ai-gen.keywords: azure service-principal,add service principal credentials,netapp credentials,account public id,govcloud location

ai-gen.lead: Updates service principal credentials associated with the specified account public ID. Use this to manage authentication details for service principals in your account.
ai-gen.keywords: azure credentials,update credentials,service principal,account public id,credentials id

ai-gen.lead: Retrieves an existing service principal by its account public ID. Use this to access details about a specific service principal for authentication or authorization purposes.
ai-gen.keywords: service principal,azure credentials,account public id,credentials id,netapp ontap

ai-gen.lead: Generates an Azure token using existing service principal credentials. Use this to authenticate requests with a NetApp Console user token or service token.
ai-gen.keywords: azure token,service principal,generate token,azure credentials,token generation

ai-gen.lead: Generates an Azure token by using service principal credentials. Use this token for authentication in requests that require authorization headers.
ai-gen.keywords: azure token,generate token,service principal,token scopes,netapp console

ai-gen.lead: Creates and encrypts new credentials for a specified account public ID. Use this to securely manage authentication details for the account.
ai-gen.keywords: create credentials,encrypt credentials,new account credentials,account public id,credentials internal

ai-gen.lead: Retrieves a list of generic credentials by credentials type with a specified account public ID. Use this to identify and manage credentials associated with the account.
ai-gen.keywords: credentials retrieval,credentials type,account public id,generic credentials,netapp credentials

ai-gen.lead: Updates existing generic credentials. Use this to modify credential details for accessing resources securely.
ai-gen.keywords: credentials update,update credentials,generic credentials,modify credentials,account credentials,edit credentials

ai-gen.lead: Deletes generic credentials. Use this to remove credentials that are no longer needed or valid.
ai-gen.keywords: delete credentials,remove credentials,generic credentials,account credentials,credentials deletion

ai-gen.lead: Retrieves specific generic credentials based on the account public ID and credentials ID. Use this to access the details of the credentials associated with a particular account.
ai-gen.keywords: credentials retrieval,account credentials,generic credentials,decrypted credentials,account public id,credentials id

ai-gen.lead: Creates new ARN credentials for a specified account. Use this to generate credentials for accessing resources tied to the account.
ai-gen.keywords: arn credentials,assume role,aws integration,new credentials,account access

ai-gen.lead: Updates existing credentials associated with a specified account public ID. Use this to modify account credentials as needed for authentication or access management.
ai-gen.keywords: account credentials,update credentials,assume role,aws credentials,account public id,cross account

ai-gen.lead: Retrieves existing ARN credentials using the specified account public ID. Use this to access the credentials associated with an account for authentication or authorization purposes.
ai-gen.keywords: account credentials,assume role,aws arn,account id,arn credentials,credentials id

categories.title: Generic endpoints in the Credentials REST API for the NetApp Console

ai-gen.lead: Use generic endpoints to manage and secure credentials through encryption. These endpoints support operations such as creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting credentials, as well as accessing specific credentials by ID.
ai-gen.keywords: generic credentials,manage credentials,encrypt credentials,credentials id,update credentials,retrieve credentials

categories.title: AWS endpoints in the Credentials REST API for the NetApp Console

ai-gen.lead: Use AWS endpoints to manage Amazon Resource Name (ARN) credentials in your environment. Create, update, and retrieve ARN credentials to support integration with AWS services.
ai-gen.keywords: aws credentials,arn credentials,amazon resource name,manage credentials,update credentials,retrieve credentials

categories.title: Azure endpoints in the Credentials REST API for the NetApp Console

ai-gen.lead: Use Azure endpoints to manage and secure Microsoft Azure service principal credentials in your environment. Perform tasks such as creating, updating, retrieving credentials, and generating tokens for authentication workflows.
ai-gen.keywords: azure credentials,microsoft azure,service principal,encrypt credentials,generate token
